description: This file defines a Sass mixin called 'invisible' that sets the CSS 'visibility' property with an optional '!important' flag. It includes a deprecation notice indicating that the mixin is deprecated and suggesting migration to newer versions.

methods.name: invisible
methods.description: A Sass mixin that sets the CSS 'visibility' property to the given value, with an '!important' flag, and includes a deprecation warning.
